a5e51792: What is the name of the main protagonist of Attack on Titan?
Eren Yeager is the main hero — he swears to destroy every Titan after seeing his mother eaten when Wall Maria falls. His fate becomes that of all humanity.
fe6b9c2a: Which Titan appears above the wall and smashes the Shiganshina gate at the start of the series?
The Colossal Titan rises above the wall and breaks the gate with a kick. We later learn it is Bertolt Hoover, hidden among the recruits.
bfdde7ef: What are the three walls protecting humanity called, from outermost to innermost?
From outermost to innermost: Wall Maria (falls in season 1), Wall Rose (battles in season 2), Wall Sina (where the nobility lives). They are 50 meters high.
149db620: Which elite military branch explores beyond the walls?
The Survey Corps ventures outside the walls to fight Titans — Eren and his friends join it despite its reputation as a death sentence.
c7d7b642: What is the soldiers' main weapon against the Titans?
Omni-directional mobility gear (ODM gear) lets soldiers move in 3D with anchor wires and replaceable blades — the only effective way to reach the nape.
06989a88: Who is described as “humanity's strongest soldier”?
Levi Ackerman is the strongest soldier — his speed, precision and power surpass any other human. His Ackerman bloodline gives him exceptional abilities.
204a8502: Which Titan does Armin inherit from Bertolt?
Armin inherits the Colossal Titan — he is brought back from the brink by the Titan power, instead of Erwin Smith, whose death remains a painful choice for Levi.
dcc03f16: What power does the Founding Titan that Eren seeks to use have?
The Founding Titan can control every Titan and alter Eldians' memories — Eren wants to use it to start the Rumbling and wipe out every threat to Paradis.
e275e7cb: Which country oppresses the Eldians outside the walls?
Marley is the militaristic nation that oppresses the Eldians — seen as a cursed race, they are forced to live in ghettos or serve as Titan Warriors.
a9971984: Which Titan does Reiner Braun hold?
Reiner Braun holds the Armored Titan — a Marleyan warrior who infiltrated the walls. His reveal in season 2 is one of the most shocking twists of the series.
29c5c8b4: Who commands the Survey Corps in the early seasons?
Erwin Smith is the charismatic commander of the Survey Corps — a brilliant strategist who does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops for victory, a complex and fascinating character.
2469357a: What is the goal of the Rumbling started by Eren?
Wipe out all life outside Paradis
Free the Titans from the walls
The Rumbling releases the Colossal Titans from the walls to crush the entire world outside Paradis — Eren wants to eliminate every threat to the Eldians of Paradis.
3ccdf7e3: Who is Zeke Yeager and which Titan does he hold?
Zeke Yeager is Eren's half-brother, son of Grisha and Dina Fritz. Holder of the Beast Titan and a Marleyan warrior, he has royal blood.
53db7c18: How does Eren's story end in the series?
He sacrifices himself to stop the Rumbling
Eren is killed by Mikasa, who cuts off his head — a heartbreaking but necessary act to stop the Rumbling and save what remains of humanity.
fe80b604: Which Titan does Annie Leonhart use?
Annie Leonhart holds the Female Titan — an infiltrated Marleyan warrior, she uses it to try to capture Eren before encasing herself in crystal for protection.
f7df5358: What is the hometown of Eren, Mikasa and Armin?
Shiganshina is the district south of Wall Maria where Eren and his friends grow up — it is where the Colossal Titan strikes first, setting off the whole story.
0b0381c9: What does Sasha Blouse do in front of instructor Shadis on the first day of training?
During the cadets' first day, instructor Shadis catches Sasha eating a stolen potato in the middle of the drill — she offers to share it, which earns her the nickname “Potato Girl”.
258b52ae: Which iconic soldier dies at the Battle of Shiganshina in season 3?
Erwin Smith dies during the suicide charge against the Beast Titan — Levi chooses to give the serum to Armin rather than Erwin, a decision that breaks every soldier's heart.
5df5593c: Which Titan did Frieda Reiss, Historia's half-sister, hold?
Frieda Reiss, Historia's half-sister, held the Founding Titan — she erased Historia's memories after their meetings. Grisha Yeager killed and ate her to take this power.
7f0e9dc5: Which clan makes its members immune to the Founding Titan's control?
The Ackerman clan (Levi, Mikasa, Kenny) is immune to the Founding Titan's power — their ancestors, who served the royal family, kept an independent strength.
04d5f7bc: Which Titan does Marley's Pieck Finger hold?
Pieck Finger holds the Cart Titan — a four-legged form with exceptional endurance. She serves as logistical support for the Marleyan army.
92ac6fc4: How are Levi and Kenny Ackerman related?
Kenny Ackerman is Levi's maternal uncle — he raised him in the Underground. Kenny reveals their blood tie before he dies.
e3bf1626: How do Armin and the others save Trost in season 1?
By sealing the hole with stones
Eren, in Titan form, plugs the hole with a boulder
Eren uses his Titan form to lift a huge boulder and plug the hole in Trost's wall — the first strategic use of his ability, proving his worth to skeptical officers.
3c6e099e: How high are the walls protecting humanity in Attack on Titan?
Walls Maria, Rose and Sina are each 50 meters high — enough to stop ordinary Titans (2 to 15 meters) but not the 60-meter Colossal Titans.
966a46d4: Who is the first human to have obtained the power of the Titans?
Ymir Fritz is the first to obtain the power of the Titans, about 2,000 years ago. According to legend, she made a pact with the “devil of all earth”.
1664b40c: Why does Marley want to take the Founding Titan from Paradis?
To control Eldians across the world
The Founding Titan can control all Subjects of Ymir — Marley wants this power to keep total control over the enslaved Eldians on the continent and crush any resistance.
8f9ad38b: What is Levi's military rank in the Survey Corps?
Levi is a Captain (Heichō) of the Survey Corps — he leads a special squad directly under Commander Erwin Smith. Everyone respects his authority.
265766d7: Which enemy can turn the Eldians of Paradis into Titans with a scream?
Zeke Yeager, of royal blood, can turn Eldians who have ingested his spinal fluid into Pure Titans with a scream.
af7907b2: Which fictional country is the equivalent of Japan in the Attack on Titan world?
Hizuru is a nation inspired by Japan. The Azumabito clan, from which Mikasa descends through her mother, represents its interests.
61c1f72e: What is the name of Eren, Mikasa and Armin's military class?
The 104th Cadet Corps is the training class of Eren, Mikasa, Armin, Reiner, Annie and their comrades — Eren graduates fifth despite his technical weaknesses.
cd5b5ce7: What special ability does the Ackerman clan have?
The divine strength of the walls
The Ackerman clan accesses the combined combat experience of all its ancestors — superhuman reflexes and immunity to the Founding Titan. That is why Levi and Mikasa are off the charts.
799792fa: What technique do soldiers use to kill a Titan?
The only way to kill a Titan is to slice its nape, where its weak point is. ODM gear lets soldiers reach that spot.
f199601a: What is the Curse of Ymir that dooms Titan Shifters?
They can no longer have children
They die 13 years after gaining their power
The Curse of Ymir dooms every holder of the Nine Titans to die exactly 13 years after gaining their power — Ymir Fritz herself only lived 13 years with it.
ee583758: What is Eren's father's name and which Titan does he hold?
Grisha Yeager — Attack and Founding Titans
Grisha Yeager is an Eldian doctor who passed the Attack Titan on to Eren — he also held the Founding Titan stolen from Frieda Reiss. His injection radically changes Eren's destiny.
5502f3fc: Which military branch does Eren choose after his cadet training?
Eren chooses the Survey Corps despite (or because of) its reputation as a death sentence — his goal of wiping out every Titan leads him naturally to the unit that fights outside the walls.
8887c8fb: Which Survey Corps member is passionate about studying Titans?
Hange Zoë studies Titans with boundless passion and makes key discoveries about their nature. Hange later becomes commander of the Survey Corps.
3c255823: Which character is eventually revealed to be Historia's father?
Rod Reiss is Historia's biological father — he tries to convince her to eat Eren to recover the Founding Titan. Historia refuses and kills him when he turns into a giant, deformed Titan.
bdcb451a: What is the Eldian resistance movement opposing Marley?
The Eldian Restorationists are continental Eldians, many living in Liberio, who dream of freeing their people. Grisha Yeager was one of them before being captured and sent to Paradis.
6b4e6cec: How does Eren first trigger the Founding Titan's power, at the end of season 2?
He touches Historia and bonds with her
He touches the Smiling Titan (Dina Fritz, royal blood)
By punching the hand of the Smiling Titan, a Pure Titan, Eren makes contact with Dina Fritz, who has royal blood. This contact lets him command the Titans for a brief moment.
afdf8f82: Who succeeds Erwin Smith as commander of the Survey Corps?
After Erwin's death, Hange Zoë takes command of the Survey Corps.
e425fc20: What is Zeke Yeager's real plan for the Eldians, which he calls “euthanasia”?
Sterilize all Subjects of Ymir through the Founding Titan so they die out naturally
Turn every Eldian into a Pure Titan
Zeke wants to use the Founding Titan to sterilize all Subjects of Ymir — the Eldians would die out within a generation without suffering. He sees it as an act of compassion to end the cycle.
6ee9e2c6: What decision does Levi make about the Titan serum at the Battle of Shiganshina?
He gives the serum to Erwin
He gives the serum to Armin
Levi chooses Armin over the dying Erwin to receive the Titan serum — one of the most heartbreaking decisions of the series. He sacrifices the commander he admired to save Eren's young friend.
e133489e: How is one of the Nine Titans passed from one holder to the next?
By eating a holder of one of the Nine Titans

The Nine Titans are passed on by eating the holder — when a Pure Titan eats a Titan Shifter, it turns back into a human and inherits the Titan. That is how Armin inherited the Colossal Titan from Bertolt.
a2a0d3f7: What does Ymir Fritz's story reveal about the origin of the Titans' power?
She came into contact with a mysterious creature inside a giant tree
She stole it from a god
She created the Titans for revenge
Ymir Fritz, a hunted slave, falls into the hollow of a giant tree, where a strange creature merges with her. When she dies, King Fritz forces their daughters to eat her body to keep the power alive.
6c4874b2: How does Historia officially become queen of Paradis?
She is crowned after the Survey Corps' coup
After the Survey Corps overthrows the false king, Historia, heir of the Reiss family, is crowned queen.
37b853be: Which Mid-East Allied Forces fortress does Marley besiege at the start of season 4?
Fort Slava is the Mid-East Allied Forces' stronghold. Marley only takes it by deploying its Titans, which convinces its leaders that their military edge is coming to an end.
e3ee9525: Which of the Nine Titans does Ymir, the cadet, hold, and how did she get it?
Jaw Titan, by eating Marcel Galliard
Ymir, then a Pure Titan, devoured Marcel Galliard, a Marleyan warrior, and inherited the Jaw Titan. This Titan is small but very agile.
c3dc6598: Who is the author of the Attack on Titan manga?
Hajime Isayama published Attack on Titan from 2009 to 2021 in Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine.
7fc52fb5: Which studio takes over the anime from the final season onward?
WIT Studio animated the first three seasons. MAPPA took over for the final season, from 2020.
bc8c3189: What is the original Japanese title of Attack on Titan?
“Shingeki no Kyojin” can be translated as “the Attack Titan”, which takes on its full meaning later in the story.
0dba9ecc: What is the name of Eren's mother?
Carla Yeager is devoured by a Titan before Eren's eyes when Wall Maria falls.
8fecda6e: Which Garrison soldier saves Eren and Mikasa on the day Wall Maria falls?
Hannes, a friend of the Yeager family, carries the children away from the Titan devouring Carla.
8b03ed22: Which item does Mikasa wear in memory of Eren?
As a child, Eren wrapped his scarf around Mikasa's neck. She almost never takes it off.
c9e59c15: What has Armin dreamed of since childhood?
Armin dreams of seeing the ocean, which he discovered in a forbidden book. He eventually gazes at it with Eren and Mikasa.
f5460c37: How many of the Nine Titans exist?
The Nine Titans are the Founding, Attack, Colossal, Armored, Female, Beast, Jaw, Cart and War Hammer Titans.
c02654c7: Which of the Nine Titans does Eren inherit from his father, in addition to the Founding Titan?
Grisha passes on to Eren the Attack Titan, which he held, along with the Founding Titan stolen from the Reiss family.
51e53f02: Roughly how tall is the Colossal Titan?
The Colossal Titan is about 60 meters tall, enough to look over the 50-meter walls.
0327439a: What is the name of the Eldian internment zone in Marley?
Marley's Eldians are confined to the Liberio internment zone, home of Reiner, Annie and the other warriors.
4ee225fc: Who kills Sasha Blouse during the raid on Liberio?
On board the airship, Gabi Braun shoots Sasha with a rifle, devastating her comrades.
4cf1714d: Who commands the Garrison in the Trost District?
Commander Dot Pixis, eccentric but respected, approves the plan that lets Eren seal the breach in Trost.
3d6f3e4b: Where do the names of the three walls, Maria, Rose and Sina, come from?
The walls are named after Maria, Rose and Sina, Ymir Fritz's three daughters.
a077826f: In what year does the Attack on Titan manga end?
The last chapter, the 139th, came out in April 2021. The anime ended in November 2023.
0febcf82: Which village does Connie Springer come from?
Connie comes from the village of Ragako, whose inhabitants, including his mother, were turned into Titans.
